name: Rift Modern
author: Taurus0815
description: Rift-inspired HUD, camera-directed shoulder hip fire, held-only aim zoom, responsive movement and a paused weapon-picture wheel.

settings.name: Aim + melee: wrench throw
settings.description: Hold the real aim action and press melee (Square/X by default) to perform the native Comet Strike. Shoulder-walk alone still uses normal melee. Launcher bindings are preserved.

settings.name: Double-tap aim for shoulder movement
settings.description: Two short aim taps toggle shoulder framing plus camera-relative side/back movement. Starts off. A held aim button remains temporary aiming; launcher controls and native collision are preserved.
Original game health works standalone. External mode delegates health display to a separately installed compatible Nanotech HUD.
settings.name: Health source

settings.description: J by default. Avoid keys assigned to game actions.
settings.name: Toggle movement key

settings.description: K by default. Match the Rift health key under Arsenal Mastery.
settings.name: Toggle HUD key
Modern menus
settings.description: Themes title/load/options, pause and its subpages, vendor and dialogs in navy, cyan and violet. Original menu view remains available with the menu key.

settings.name: Rift controller menu Back
settings.description: Circle/B returns from menus with the installed LT-aim/RT-fire layout. Disable after changing legacy L2 away from Circle/B.

settings.name: Original menu view key
settings.description: Toggle the native pause-menu view while paused.

settings.name: Wrench swing speed
settings.description: Grounded wrench swings only; 1.0 restores original speed. Damage per hit is unchanged.

settings.name: Pause during Quick Select
settings.description: Hold Triangle/Y for a radial selector with real native Pause. Release to equip and resume. Circle/B cancels.
Jump + wrench animation speed; preserves native landing physics.
settings.name: Overhead wrench speed

settings.description: Extra crate wave when the overhead strike lands. Set 0 for original reach.
settings.name: Overhead crate radius (m)

settings.description: Native wrench damage to nearby enemies on overhead ground impact. Set 0 to disable.
settings.name: Overhead enemy radius (m)

settings.description: Multiplier of native bolt magnet distance and height.
settings.name: Bolt attraction radius
